title: Alignment & Strategy — Jaya ⇄ Kevin (API / Console / Dedicated / Private)
agenda:
1) Quick signal check (health, incidents, blockers)
2) Console feature prioritization for Dedicated customers
3) Private deployment onboarding friction points
4) Short-term infra experiments (batching / prefix cache)
5) Action items and owners
background: Context: Product is targeting a mid-March pilot for Dedicated customers with Console-managed rollouts. Kevin raised concerns about peak tail latency and a possible config surface in Console that lets SREs toggle aggressive batching. We also want to make the private onboarding checklist less prescriptive so infra partners can reuse the same checklist for VPC and on-prem pilots.
discussion_points:
- Health/metrics: recent Dedicated pool p95 spiked from 95ms -> 140ms during the 02/07 burst; looks correlated with long-sequence embed jobs.
- Console: current UX exposes 'global batch window' and 'max request size' knobs in advanced settings. Ops confusion: teams toggling both and creating latency regressions.
- Private: AD onboarding time ~6 weeks; biggest drag is network validation and KMS integration.
- Experiment: trial prefix/KV cache for 2 high-volume customers to reduce token compute on repeated prompts. Need to scope rollback and observability.
- Cost tradeoffs: quantized model variant saves ~20%/token but increases p99 latency ~15ms in baseline. Need policy gating in Console to recommend quantized variant for background batch jobs only.
decisions:
- Do NOT expose both 'global batch window' and 'max request size' directly in primary Console flow; move to 'advanced' with inline recommended defaults.
- Start two-week pilot (A/B) of prefix cache with customer X/Y; monitor p95/p99, token savings, and cache hit rate.
- Add a KMS checklist item for private onboarding: pre-provisioned key + sample decrypt test to run during infra validation.
- Ship a Console tooltip that recommends quantized variants for batch endpoints and links to Optimize suggestions.
action_items: Kevin: Prototype a Console UI change that collapses batch knobs into an 'Advanced batch tuning' panel — due 2025-02-24
Jaya: Draft customer-facing note for Dedicated pilot describing expected behavior during burst windows — due 2025-02-20
Asha: Define success criteria for prefix cache pilot (target: 15% token compute reduction, p95 < 130ms) and add to JIRA INF-789 — due 2025-02-19
Infra (owner TBD): Add a KMS pre-provision + decrypt smoke test to private-onboard checklist; include sample Terraform snippet — due 2025-03-03
SRE: Add per-route quantized-variant telemetry to Console cost dashboard (tokens, avg latency, p99) — due 2025-03-01
open_questions: If prefix cache is effective, do we want it enabled by default for hosted API customers? (risk: cold-start miss storms)
How many Dedicated customers will accept rolling quantized model variants in production? Need customer opt-in vs forced policy.
Who will own the 'private onboarding' runbook updates (Docs vs Solutions Eng vs Infra)?
meeting_log:
02/12 sync notes: Kevin walked through the burst timeline and traced to a set of long-embedding pipelines. Suggested short-term mitigation: route these to a lower-priority Dedicated pool. Jaya pushed to keep Console defaults conservative. Agreed: implement UI changes and pilot cache.
Follow-up on 02/18: quick check-in — Kevin demoed a UI mock; Asha posted acceptance criteria to JIRA; Jaya sent draft pilot note to the pilot list.
